acceptanceCriteria: affected JSON output carries a tier per selected package without changing the full selection
A test covers a change whose direct importers are selected in tier 1 and transitive dependents in tier 2
body: On 2026-10-21, corvint affected for a change confined to internal/liveverify/affected selected 135 packages, too many to run locally under the host semaphore, so lanes fall back to hand-picked focused tests and miss importers. Proposal: keep the full sound selection, and add tiers (tier 0 changed packages, tier 1 siblings plus direct importers, tier 2 the rest) with counts, so a lane can run tier 0+1 locally and leave tier 2 to CI with the gap recorded.

Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 919ac1dc389aeeb9e8f1b989ee63985816b671fb4c779aaaaeafd93b025ee8a7.

title: corvint affected selects 135 packages for a one-package change; emit a tiered direct-dependents subset usable locally
